verdict.rationale: AnyDesk's CLI docs show a deployment script that installs AnyDesk, registers the license and sets a password, so credentials can be configured in advance without manual setup on each machine. However, the evidence never explicitly says this password lets incoming connections succeed without someone at the host accepting them. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the preset password enables unattended access with no host-side acceptance, documentation of unattended-access permission settings, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can set up unattended access to a machine with credentials configured in advance, so no one has to sit at the host to accept

citations.quote: The following example batch script installs AnyDesk, registers the license key, and sets a password
Automating tasks such as installation, licensing, password setup, and removal
You can use CLI commands with software deployment tools to install and configure AnyDesk on multiple devices, without manual setup on each machine.
